correctness.rationale: RESULT.md Git blob 9c4063c98f5798231dde5274807d61f5c0f1d87d: for original cycle E, every proper arc subset is a directed forest and Y=partial Delta(E)=S^{n-2}. Shortcut s conflicts only at arcs e_0 and e_{k-1}; the only further forbidden subset is s with all return-path arcs B={e_k,...,e_{n-1}}. Thus lk_X(s)=Delta(A)*partial Delta(B) with A={e_1,...,e_{k-2}}, and X=Y union_s Cone(L). When k>=3, apex e_1 makes L a cone and explicit paired free faces remove the shortcut, total 2^{k-3}(2^{n-k}-1) collapses, including |B|=1 boundary. When k=2, L=partial Delta^{n-3}=S^{n-4}, inclusion into S^{n-2} nullhomotopic by connectivity (also n=4, S^0 into connected S^2), yielding wedge with suspension. Independent full arc-subset enumeration and link checks for n=4..9 agree; finite checks not taken as proof.
